explanation: This test case only attempts to verify that the FX rate is locked at the moment of top-up initiation (fx_lock). It does not cover the transactional ordering of credit before debit (credit_before_debit) nor the dual approval requirement for large top-ups (dual_approval). The test only checks that the FX rate shown matches the rate at initiation, but does not verify that the rate remains locked throughout the transaction or that the funding source is debited only after the wallet is credited. It also does not test rollback behavior on callback timeout or the approval workflow for top-ups above SGD 10,000.
missingAssertions: Verify that the destination wallet is credited before the funding source is debited
Verify that top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement
Verify rollback occurs if payment provider callback times out after 5 seconds
hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: A bug where the funding source is debited before the destination wallet is credited would not be caught by this test. Also, a bug where top-ups above SGD 10,000 proceed without second-owner approval would be missed.

suggestedReplacement.description: Verify full top-up transaction flow including FX rate lock, credit-before-debit ordering, rollback on timeout, and dual approval for large amounts
steps: Initiate top-up of USD 100 and record FX rate at initiation
Verify that the FX rate used for credit matches the locked rate
Confirm that the destination wallet is credited before the funding source is debited
Simulate payment provider callback timeout after 5 seconds and verify transaction rollback (no debit or credit)
Verify that the system requires approval from a second business owner before settling
Approve the top-up and verify settlement completes successfully
suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: FX rate is locked at initiation; destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited; transaction rolls back if callback times out after 5 seconds; top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement
